say:1:1130716001:1.text: Haven't you heard? The Quicksand Claws have been defeated and disbanded by a warrior!
say:1:1130716001:1.source_cn: 你没听说吗，流沙之爪被一位勇士打散了！

say:2:1130716002:1.text: Rumors came from the clan members who returned. But... there are several different witness accounts of the warrior.
say:2:1130716002:1.source_cn: 那些失踪的部落成员回来说的，不过……那些声称见过勇士的...

say:3:1130716003:1.text: Some described this person as a tall and muscular fighter, while others saw a shaman with a brilliant golden glow.
say:3:1130716003:1.source_cn: 有的说是身材魁梧健硕的高大战士，有人说是浑身散发着灿金...

say:4:1130716004:1.text: I wish to meet them in person. Anyway, his legend will be passed down in the Crimson Highlands from generation to generation.
say:4:1130716004:1.source_cn: 有生之年，真想见见啊，相信那位勇士的传奇故事会在深红高...
